body: OMAR SIAL, J. Mashooque Ali and Sultan (applicants) have sought the above captioned post-arrest bail arising out of same crime number 08 of 2026 registered under section 397 P.P.C. at the Site police station District Hyderabad. Their earlier bail applications were dismissed on 31.03.2026 and 21.05.2026 respectively by the learned 1 st Additional Sessions Judge/Model Criminal Trial Court, Hyderabad.

2- The allegations against the applicants/accused are that on 20.01.2026, at about 1430 hours, while duly armed with pistols, they intercepted a Suzuki vehicle (bearing registration No. CT-1423) engaged in the distribution and sale of medicines for Premier Sales Private Limited. It is alleged that when the driver did not stop upon being brandished with pistols, the accused opened fire, injuring the driver, Shahbaz. Consequently, the vehicle came to a halt, whereupon the applicants/accused allegedly robbed cash amounting to Rs. 1,33,725/- from the complainant/supervisor.
3- Heard the learned counsel for the applicants as well as the learned Assistant Prosecutor General, Sindh.

4- Notice was duly served upon the complainant, but he failed to appear. Learned counsel for the applicants has placed on record a certified copy of the complainant’s testimony recorded in Case No. 448 of 2026, currently pending before the learned 5th Additional Sessions Judge, Hyderabad. In his examination-in-chief, the complainant categorically stated that the present applicants were not among the persons who robbed him, and further deposed that he had never nominated them as accused.

5- In view of the above circumstances, the case against the applicants falls within the purview of further inquiry as contemplated under Section 497(2) Cr.P.C. Accordingly, the applicants are admitted to post-arrest bail, subject to their furnishing solvent surety in the sum of Rs.250,000/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty Thousand) each, along with a personal bond in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
J U D G E Ahmed/Pa,
